items.title: IRGC Navy claims container ship sank after striking mine south of Hormuz
items.summary: Iranian state media on Wednesday (Oct 14) shared an IRGC Navy statement saying a container ship carrying 2,500+ containers sank south of the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine while on what the Guards called an 'unauthorised and dangerous route'; the statement warned local vessels and fishermen to take care. No vessel identity, flag, crew status, or independent/UKMTO confirmation; first IRGC mine claim against a container ship (Oct 10-12 claims were tankers). Iranian-state-only, so unconfirmed.
